usage: - A common noun for a cactus. In everyday Cantonese, it refers to the plant with thick stems and spines.
- Often used when talking about houseplants, gardens, or desert plants. It is a very straightforward word for learners.
- Can be used with classifiers like 一棵仙人掌 or 呢盆仙人掌 when counting or describing the plant.
- In casual speech, people may use it when warning others not to touch the spines or when describing a plant as hardy and low-maintenance.
